data.name: BlazePunk
data.detailed_description:
In this fast-paced genre blend of skating game, stylish combat and roguelite horde action, you rebel against a Corpo cult that’s oppressing the whole city and ignite the resistance.

The cult keeps the city under its control through so-called ‘Amen Breaks’: forced mass events where entire districts are cordoned off and residents are blasted with propaganda.

Your response: your music, your style and your skateboard sword.

With your self-curated mixtapes – your sounds of rebellion – you storm the Corpo Cult’s Amen Breaks, hijack their propaganda loudspeakers and takeover their frequency to sabotage their propaganda and remind people once again what it means to be free.

Each Amen Break presents you with a new challenge, in which you must reach the required Rebellion Score before the cult overwhelms you. The more stylishly you fight your way through the cult’s Enforcers, the stronger your rebellion becomes.

Skate and grind through the city

Your most important tool and your best friend is your skateboard. With it, you can race through the city streets, grind on rails, pull off tricks and use your surroundings to navigate the city in style.

Keep moving and maintain your momentum as you transform the whole city into your own personal skate park.

Fight your way through hordes of enemies

The Cult won’t just stand by and watch you sabotage its propaganda. Its enforcers are always on standby, ready to suppress any resistance before it begins. But you know how to fight back.

With your skateboard sword, you throw yourself into the fray. Dash straight at enemies, fling them into the air and combine attacks with tricks to strike quickly and unexpectedly, defeating the cult’s henchmen.

Create your own mixtapes

Your most important weapon against the propaganda of the Corpo cult: your music.

During your runs, you’ll constantly collect new tracks, each bringing their own effects and gameplay modifications. Combine these to create your own mixtapes and experiment to find out which combinations suit your play style best.

Between runs, you can return to your recording studio to put together new mixtapes using your newly collected tracks and combine new effects.

data.short_description: In BlazePunk, you have to fight a conformist corpo-cult that keeps your city under its authoritarian grip. Skate through the city, disrupt cult gatherings by hijacking brainwashing speakers and fight their enforcers to liberate the people and ignite resistance.

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
